cohort: Women with a singleton full-term pregnancy and single prior Caesarean section
finding: While the rate of vaginal delivery after induction of labor with oxytocin infusion was satisfactory, maternal morbidity and the risk of uterine rupture were not insignificant.
mod_finding: The study found a vaginal delivery rate of 58.5% among women with a single prior Caesarean section who were induced into labor with oxytocin.
